description: Erect, glabrous shrub up to 4 m with long, drooping branches; thorns 1 or 2 divergent in the leaf axils, up to 10–15 mm long, articulate at base, easily breakable. Stipules 2, minute, subulate. Leaves variable from suborbicular to ovate or elliptic, rounded or acute with pointed apex, terminated by a 1–2 mm thorn-like structure; upper surface shining; midrib prominent, 2–6 by 1.5–6 cm; petiole 2–8 mm. Inflorescences racemes or panicles in the leaf axils and larger panicles up to 25 cm terminal on the shoots. Bracts and floral parts persistent after flowering. Flowers yellowish green, polygamous. Male flowers crowded, subsessile; calyx ± deeply divided ca 2 mm; petals slightly longer, green, often finely serrate in upper part; filaments longer than corolla, anthers oblong. Female flowers: pedicel up to 8 mm; calyx and petals somewhat shorter than in the male flowers; staminodes with sterile, sagittate anthers, shorter than corolla; ovary imperfectly 4-loculed; stigma deeply bifid. Berry white, globose, 5–6 mm diam. Seeds (1–)2–3.
bibliographicCitation: Azima sarmentosa. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 341. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Annual or biennial herb up to 1 m with young stems glandular and with a strong smell of terpentine. Leaves broadly lanceolate to elliptic, 3–10(–20) by 2–3(–9) cm, attenuate at base, irregularly dentate, rarely laciniate or nearly entire; velvetly glandulose along the nerves. Inflorescence pyramidal, richly branced, leafy panicles, consisting of cymes with 2–10(–25) sessile flowers. The numerous leaves subtending the side branches of the inflorescence are diminishing towards apex. Perianth green, 1–1.5 mm with lobes free to the middle or more. Stamens 4(–5) or less, slightly exserted. Ovary spherical; stigmata 3. Seeds obovoid, 0.5–0.8 mm, subglabrous, dark brown, shining.
bibliographicCitation: Chenopodium ambrosioides. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 254. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Annual herb up to 1 m. Stems covered by vescicular hairs giving the plant a mealy touch. Leaves rhomboid to lanceolate, with sinuate margin, up to 7 by 4 cm, diminishing in upper parts to 1–2 by 0.7–1.5 cm, attenuate at base, obtuse-mucronate at apex, upper surface green, lower greyish, mealy. Inflorescence richly branched, leafy in lower part. Perianth divided to about the middle; lobes carinate. Stamens 5. Ovary spherical-ovoid. Fruit with perianth pentagonal in outline. Seeds discoid, ca 1 mm diam., black, shining with numerous radial lines.
bibliographicCitation: Chenopodium ficifolium. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 254. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub to tree, young shoots glabrous. Leaves coriaceous to subcoriaceous; petiole 7–10 mm long, glabrous; lamina glabrous, broadly oblanceolate-obovate, (6–)8–11 cm long, (2.5–)3–6.5 cm broad; base acute, attenuate onto the petiole; apex rounded-obtuse to retuse, usually with a short retrorse apiculum; 6–7 primary veins on each side of the midrib, slightly raised above and below, reticulate venation sometimes visible below. Inflorescence axillary, racemose-decussate to paniculate, 1–4 cm long, 5- to many flowered; flowers fragrant; rachis single or paired, glabrous; pedicels 0.5–1 mm long (to 3 mm in fruit). Calyx glabrous; tube 0.5 mm; lobes acutely triangular, 0.5–0.75 mm long. Corolla white; lobes strap-shaped, 2–3 mm long, 0.5–0.75 mm broad. Anthers very broadly ellipsoid, 1 mm long; filaments 0.5 mm long; connective not developed. Ovary bottle-shaped, 1 mm long; style scarcely differentiated, 0.25 mm long, stigma ± sessile, slightly 2-lobed. Fruit black when ripe, 10–11 mm long, 7–8 mm diameter.
bibliographicCitation: Chionanthus amblirrhinus. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 292. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Small tree, 4–6 m tall, young shoots minutely velutinous to puberulous. Leaves somewhat coriaceous; petiole 3–5 mm long, minutely villous to puberulous; lamina elliptic to broadly elliptic, (3–)4–6.5 cm long, (1.5–)2–3 cm broad; base acute or obtuse, slightly decurrent onto the petiole; apex ± acuminate, often shortly so; 5–6 primary veins on each side of the midrib, usually obscure, sometime slightly raised below. Inflorescence short and dense, to 1 cm long, 3–5-flowered; rachis velutinous; flowers sessile. Calyx lobes 1 mm long, obtuse, densely shortly pilose. Corolla white; lobes strap-shaped (4–)5–6 mm long; 0.5 mm broad, usually curled. Anthers broadly ellipsoid, about 0.75 mm long; filament about 0.5 mm long; connective slightly developed. Ovary flask-shaped, 2 mm long; style 0.5 mm, scarcely differentiated, stigma shallowly 2-lobed. Fruit ellipsoid, (0.6–)0.7 x (0.3–)0.4 cm.
bibliographicCitation: Chionanthus calcicola. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 290. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree to ca 8 m. tall, young shoots glabrous. Leaves coriaceous; petiole stout, 1–2 cm long, glabrous; lamina glabrous, broadly oblanceolate, 20–30 cm long, 9–12 cm broad; base ± cuneate; apex very abruptly acuminate; 7–8 primary veins on each side of the midrib, raised above and below, secondary venation obscure. Inflorescence fascicled, racemose-decussate, from the axillary scars of shed leaves, 0.5–2 cm long, glabrous; flowers numerous, ± sessile. Calyx ciliolate, tube and lobes 1 mm long, lobes triangular, rounded. Corolla: (from Malayan material) lobes narrow, 5 mm long. Anthers not seen. Ovary broadly flask-shaped, 1 mm long; style 0.5 mm long, stigma very shallowly bilobed. Fruit (from Malayan material) ellipsoid, base flattened, 2.5 x 1.2 cm.
bibliographicCitation: Chionanthus callophyllus. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 287. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Small tree to 7 m tall, young shoots finely velutinous. Leaves coriaceous, glabrous above, except the midrib, usually velutinous, rarely the midrib only puberulous below; petiole finely velutinous, 7–10 mm long; lamina oblong-elliptic, 19–34 cm long, 6–11 cm broad; base acute; apex shortly and finely acuminate; 9–10 primary veins on each side of the midrib, raised below, sunk above, otherwise obscure. Inflorescence racemose-decussate, 0.5–2 cm long; rachis finely pilose to subvelutinous; about 7- to 11-flowered; bracts 1 mm long, velutinous; flowers sessile to subsessile. Calyx glabrous, margins pilose, 1 mm long; tube very short. Corolla lobes strap-shaped, 3–4 mm long, 0.5 mm broad, ± involute. Anthers ellipsoid, 1–1.25 mm long, ± sessile; connective shortly developed. Ovary ovoid, 1 mm long; stigma ± sessile, slightly 2 lobed. Fruit not seen.
bibliographicCitation: Chionanthus decipiens. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 289. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree, young shoots glabrous. Leaves somewhat chartaceous; petioles 3–5 mm long, glabrous; lamina elliptic, 5–7 cm long, 1.5–2.7 cm broad; base subcuneate, attenuate onto the petiole; apex acuminate; 4 or 5 primary veins on each side of the midrib, slightly raised above and below, venation otherwise obscure. Inflorescence racemose decussate, 1–1.5 cm long, usually 7-flowered; rachis pilose or villous to densely villous in places; pedicels 0–0.5 mm long. Calyx ± pilose, especially on the margins; tube 0.5 mm long; lobes triangular to rounded, 0.5 mm long. Corolla lobes 2.5 mm long, 0.4–0.5 mm broad, cuspidate. Anthers ellipsoid, 0.75 mm long; connective rounded, scarcely developed. Ovary flask-shaped, 0.75 mm long; style 0.5 mm long, stigma very slightly 2-lobed. Fruit not known.
bibliographicCitation: Chionanthus eriorachis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 291. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree to 15 m tall, young shoots glabrous. Leaves slightly coriaceous; petiole 2–4 cm long, glabrous; lamina glabrous, lanceolate to oblong, 11–18 cm long, 5.5–6.6 cm broad; base acute, attenuate onto the petiole; apex ± acuminate; 6–10 primary veins on each side of the midrib, raised above and below. Inflorescence racemose-decussate, 2–4 cm long, about 7-flowered, rachis glabrous; bracts 1–2 mm long, long acute; pedicels 0.5–1 mm long. Calyx glabrous; tube 0.5 mm long; lobes 0.5–0.75 mm long, acutely triangular. Corolla white; lobes strap-shaped, 7–8.5 mm long, 0.5–0.75 mm broad, involute. Anthers very broadly ellipsoid, 1 mm long; filaments 0.5 mm long; connective not developed. Ovary bottle-shaped, 1 mm long; style scarcely differentiated, 0.25 mm long, stigma broadly and slightly 2-lobed. Fruit not known.
bibliographicCitation: Chionanthus maxwellii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 292. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrubs or small trees, ca 8–15 m tall; young shoots glabrous. Leaves somewhat coriaceous; petiole glabrous, 2–4 cm long; lamina glabrous, oblong-elliptic to slightly obovate, (9–)11–24 cm long, (3.5–)4.5–10 cm broad; base cuneate, long attenuate onto the petiole; apex shortly acuminate, 7–9 primary veins on each side of the midrib, raised above, ± sunk below, secondary venation obscure. Inflorescence fasciculate, briefly paniculate, glabrous, 1–4 cm long, flowers numerous; pedicels 0.5–1 mm long. Calyx glabrous, ± membranous; tube 0.25–0.5 mm long; lobes rounded, 0.25–0.5 mm long. Corolla white or light yellow; lobes narrowly elliptic, 1.5–2 mm long, 0.5–1 mm broad, involute. Anthers broadly ellipsoid, 0.75–1 mm long, ± sessile. Ovary flask-shaped, 1 mm long; style scarcely differentiated, 0.25 mm long, stigma slightly 2-lobed. Fruit ellipsoid, 1.5–2.5 x 1 cm.
bibliographicCitation: Chionanthus microbotrys. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 283. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree, 6–15 m tall, young shoots glabrous. Leaves somewhat coriaceous; petiole 5–10 mm long, glabrous; lamina glabrous, narrowly ovate to broadly lanceolate or elliptic-oblong, (5–)6–11 cm long, (1.5–)2–4.5 cm broad; base usually acute, shortly attenuate onto the petiole; apex acuminate; 5–7 primary veins on each side of the midrib slightly raised to ± obscure below, slightly sunk to ± obscure above, other venation obscure. Inflorescence racemose-decussate to slightly paniculate, 2–5 cm long, (3–)5–7 flowered; rachis glabrous or finely puberulous; pedicels 0.5–3 mm long. Calyx puberulous to glabrous and ciliolate; tube 0.5–0.75 mm long; lobes triangular, 0.75–1 mm long, blunt to acute. Corolla white; tube 2.5–3 mm long; lobes narrowly triangular, 4–9 mm long, 0.5–1 mm broad. Anthers ellipsoid-ovoid, 1 mm long, subsessile; connective slightly developed into a very short rounded appendage. Ovary flask shaped, 1.5 mm long; style 0.5 mm long, stigma very small, 2-lobed. Fruit almost spherical, 1.5–1.7 x 1.3–1.5 cm.
bibliographicCitation: Chionanthus microstigma. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 291. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or small tree, 3–6 m tall, young shoots glabrous. Leaves ± chartaceous; petiole 1–4 mm long, glabrous; lamina glabrous, ovate to lanceolate or elliptic-oblong, (4.5–)5–0 cm long, (1.5–)2–4 cm broad; base acute to somewhat obtuse; apex acuminate to usually almost caudate; 4–6 primary veins on each side of the midrib, raised below, slightly impressed above. Inflorescence about 1 cm long; rachis glabrous or scattered puberulous, few-flowered. Calyx somewhat membranous, somewhat puberulous; lobes about 1 mm long. Corolla white; lobes linear 5–6 mm long, involute. Anthers ellipsoid, 1 mm long, subsessile; connective slightly developed. Ovary bottle shaped, about 1.5 mm long; style scarcely differentiated, stigma shallowly 2-lobed. Fruit narrowly ovoid-ellipsoid, 1–1.5 x 0.6–0.7 cm.
bibliographicCitation: Chionanthus parkinsonii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 290. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or small tree, young shoots glabrous. Leaves slightly coriaceous; petioles (1.5–)2–3 cm long, glabrous; lamina glabrous, oblong-elliptic, sometimes somewhat lanceolate or oblanceolate, (7–)9–15(–21) cm long, (2.5–)3.5–5.5(–8) cm broad; base obtuse to acute, narrowed and attenuate onto the petiole; apex acuminate to shortly acuminate; 8–9 primary veins on each side of the midrib, raised, secondary venation often obscure; petioles glabrous, (1.5–)2–3 cm long. Inflorescence paniculate, (4–)7–12(–15) cm long, glabrous; flowers numerous; pedicels 1–2 mm long. Calyx glabrous; tube 0.25 mm long; lobes 0.5–0.75 mm long, triangular. Corolla white, creamy white or yellowish (red or orange rarely recorded), slightly fragrant; lobes strap-shaped, 2–4 mm long, 0.75 mm broad, involute, apex ± obtuse. Anthers broadly ellipsoid, 0.75 mm long, almost sessile; connective developed into a very slight appendage. Ovary broadly flask shaped, 1–1.5 mm long; style short, scarcely differentiated, stigma ± sessile, slightly 2 lobed. Fruit ellipsoid, 1.5–2 × 0.8–1.5 cm.
bibliographicCitation: Chionanthus ramiflorus. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 283. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree, 4–9 m tall, young shoots glabrous. Leaves slightly coriaceous; petiole glabrous, 1.5–3 cm long; lamina glabrous, oblanceolate to broadly oblanceolate, (10–)16–20(–32) cm long, (3.5–)6–8(–11) cm broad; base cuneate, attenuate onto the petiole; apex very shortly acuminate; (9–)10–11(–13) primary veins on each side of the midrib, venation raised-reticulate below, plane or slightly raised above. Inflorescence glabrous, broadly paniculate, (3–)5–15 cm long; many-flowered, flowers scented; pedicels 0–1.5 mm long. Calyx glabrous; tube 0.25–0.5 mm long; lobes triangular, 0.5–0.75 mm long. Corolla white to pale yellow; lobes linear, 3.5–4 mm long, 0.5 mm broad, slightly involute. Anthers 1 mm long, ± sessile; connective not developed. Ovary 1.5 mm long, merging into style 0.25 mm long; stigma slightly 2-lobed. Fruit almost spherical, 2 x 1.5 cm.
bibliographicCitation: Chionanthus sutepensis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 289. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree, 8–20 m tall, young shoots glabrous to finely pilose. Leaves thinly coriaceous; petiole 1.5–3.5 cm long, glabrous, to sometimes slightly pilose; lamina glabrous, oblanceolate to elliptic oblong, (7–)11–18(–28) cm long, (2.5–)4–6(–7) cm broad; base acute, attenuate onto the petiole; apex acuminate, often shortly so; 9–12 primary veins on each side of the midrib, raised above and below, usually obscure. Inflorescence paniculate, 4–8 cm long, pubescent to pilose or almost glabrous, flowers ± sessile, numerous, in groups of 3 at the ends of the rachis branches; lower bracts leaf-like, 3–10 mm long. Calyx puberulous; tube 0.25–0.5 mm long; lobes triangular, 0.75–1 mm long. Corolla white; lobes very narrowly blunt triangular, 2–3 mm long. Anthers ellipsoid, 1 mm long, sessile; connective slightly developed. Ovary bottle-shaped, 1 mm long; stigma 0.9 small, bilobed. Fruit ellipsoid-ovoid, 1.8–3.5 × 1.3–2 cm, blue-black when ripe.
bibliographicCitation: Chionanthus thorelii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 287. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree, young shoots velutinous. Leaves coriaceous; petiole 1–2.5 cm long, velutinous; lamina velutinous below, glabrous above except for the midrib, oblanceolate, 12–21 cm long, 5–7 cm broad; base cuneate, attenuate onto the petiole; apex obtuse to acute, sometimes very slightly acuminate; 8–10 primary veins on each side of the midrib, raised below, sunk above, venation otherwise obscure. Inflorescence paniculate, 4–8 cm long, rachis velutinous; many-flowered, flowers ± sessile, sweetly scented. Calyx densely pilose; tube 0.5 mm long; lobes triangular, 1–1.25 mm long. Corolla white or yellowish-white; lobes narrowly blunt triangular, 4-5.5 mm long, 0.5 mm broad, involute. Anthers 1.25–1.5 mm long, ± sessile; connective slightly developed. Ovary bottle-shaped, 1 mm long; style 0.5 mm long, stigma sessile, slightly 2-lobed. Fruit ovoid, 2.4 x 1.3 cm.
bibliographicCitation: Chionanthus velutinus. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 289. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Spreading tree to about 7 m tall, dioecious, young shoots glabrous. Leaves 10–25 cm long, with 5–7 leaflets, leaflets ovate to oblong or elliptic, (3–)5–8(–11) cm long, (2–)2.5–4(–5) cm broad; base attenuate onto the petiole, symmetrical; apex acuminate; glabrous except for pilosity on the sides of the basal part of the midrib below and sometimes the adjacent veins; margins finely serrate; 4–6(–7) primary veins on each side of the midrib, raised above and below, venation reticulate above and below; petioles 4–6 cm long, grooved above, glabrous, lateral petiolules 3–5(–8) mm long, the terminal 8–20 mm long. Inflorescence axillary, terminal, paniculate; the female 6–12 cm long, male 4–5 cm long, many-flowered, glabrous; bracts occasional, caducous, linear lanceolate, 2–5 mm long; pedicels 3–6 mm long. Calyx glabrous, cylindrical, 1.5–2 mm long in female flowers, cupulate, 0.25–0.5 mm long in the male; lobes irregular, 0.25–1 mm long. Corolla absent. Stamens exserted; filaments 1.5–2 mm long; anthers 0.75 mm long; connective developed into a very small appendage. Ovary 1–1.5 mm long; style about 2 mm long including stigma 0.75–1 mm long. Samara narrowly oblanceolate, 3.5–4 cm long; seed unwinged for the bottom 1–1.5 cm, apex rounded.
bibliographicCitation: Fraxinus chinensis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 302. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree to 15 m tall, dioecious (?), young shoots glabrous. Leaves 15–25(–30) cm long with 5–7 leaflets, leaflets lanceolate, rarely narrowly slender, (5–)7–10(–16) cm long, (1.5–)2.5–4(–7) cm broad; base ± obtuse, very asymmetrical; apex acuminate, glabrous; margins serrate; 7–9 primary veins on each side of the midrib, raised below, immersed above, venation raised reticulate below, obscure to reticulate above; petioles 4–10 cm long, glabrous, petiolules slender, the lateral 7–20 mm long, the terminal 20–25 mm long. Inflorescence axillary, paniculate, glabrous, 10–15(–20) cm long; many-flowered, flowers unisexual ?; bracts small, very early caducous; pedicels 2–4 mm long. Calyx obconic to campanulate, glabrous; tube 0.5–0.75 mm long; lobes virtually absent or about 0.2 mm long and broadly triangular. Corolla white; lobes elliptic, 2.5–3 mm long, 0.5 mm broad. Stamens exserted; filamens about 1 mm long; anthers 2–2.5 mm long; connective developed into a small, acute appendage. Ovary ellipsoid, 1 mm long; style 2.5 mm long, stigma 1.5 mm long. Samara narrowly oblanceolate to subspathulate, 3.5 cm long, apex rounded, seed about 1 cm long, not winged.
bibliographicCitation: Fraxinus floribunda. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 302. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Small tree, monoecious, young shoots densely pale yellow-pilose. Leaves 18–30 cm long, with (9–)11–15 leaflets, leaflets elliptic, sometimes slightly lanceolate, (3.5–)5–8(–10) cm long, (1.2–)2–3(–4) cm broad; base attenuate onto the petiole, slightly asymmetrical; apex rounded or acute to somewhat acuminate; densely pilose below, scattered pilose above; entire; 7–9 primary veins on each side of the midrib, raised below, immersed above, venation otherwise obscure; petioles 3–6 cm long, densely pilose, lateral petiolules 2–5 mm long, densely pilose, the terminal 5–6 mm long, densely pilose. Inflorescence axillary, paniculate spreading, 10–20 cm long, many flowered, long pilose to villous; bracts from small much reduced pinnate leaves 2 cm long to lanceolate, 2 mm long; pedicels 1–2.5 mm long. Calyx obconic, 0.5 mm long, teeth minute or absent, glabrous. Corolla white; lobes oblong-linear, 2.5 mm long, 0.75 mm broad. Stamens exserted; filaments 0.75 mm long; anthers 2 mm long, connective appendage not developed. Ovary rounded-ellipsoid, 0.5 mm long; style 1.5 mm long, with a stigma 0.5 mm long. Samara unknown.
bibliographicCitation: Fraxinus malacophylla. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 300. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Perennial herb with slender, creeping rhizomes. Stems erect, terete, glabrous, 20–50 cm. Leaves with petiole 1.5–4 cm; lamina broadly ovate with ± cordate base, apex acuminate; 5–7-nerved, finely pubescent along the nerves. Stipules adnate to the base of the petiole, lanceolate, 5–12 mm. Inflorescence resembling a single flower, 2–2.5 cm, enlarging in fruit to 3–4 cm, on a glabrous peduncle, 1–2 cm. Petaloid bracts 4, white, obovate, glabrous, 10–15 by 5–7 mm. Stamens with filaments ca 6 mm, anthers ca 2 mm. Ovary 3-lobed with 3 divergent styles. Capsule urceolate. Seeds few, ovoid, ca 1 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Houttuynia cordata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 344. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Annual herb 10–60 cm. Stems terete, glabrous at base, ± glandular hairy in upper part. Leaves glabrous, lanceolate to linear-lanceolate, 5–9 by 0.5–2 cm, diminishing upwards. Inflorescence small cymes in the leaf axils and terminal on the shoots, covered by glandular hairs. Pedicels 2–7 mm. Bracts and bracteoles similar to the upper leaves but much smaller. Calyx divided almost to the base, glandular hairy. Corolla blue, campanulate, 5-lobed, 5–10 mm. Stamens bluish, shorter than the corolla; anthers greyish. Ovary ellipsoid, pubescent in apical part, 2-loculed; styles 2, divergent. Capsule ovoid, septicidal or irregulary dehiscent, slightly shorter than the calyx. Seeds ellipsoid, 0.3 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Hydrolea zeylanica. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 262. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Woody climber, young shoots glabrous or scattered puberulent. Leaves elliptic to oblong-elliptic, 6–15 cm long, 2.5–7 cm broad, base attenuate onto the grooved petiole; apex slightly aceminate; glabrous; 4 or 5 primary veins on each side of the midrib, raised below, but not reticulate, slightly sunk above, joining to form a distinct submarginal vein; 3–4 tufted domatia in the axils of the primary nerves with the midrib below; petioles 5–20 mm long, glabrous or pilose above. Inflorescence axillary or terminal on short shoots, 1- to 3(–5)-flowered, glabrous; bracts linear, 2 mm long; glabrous; pedicels 1–4 cm long. Calyx tube 2 mm long; lobes 5–14 mm long, somewhat filiform, glabrous. Corolla white, fragrant; tube (9–)15–20 mm long; lobes 8 or 9, 15–20 mm long, 2–3.5 mm broad. Fruit spheroidal, 7 x 5 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Jasminum adenophyllum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 315. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Woody climber, young shoots velutinous. Leaves ovate, 4–12 cm long, 2–6 cm broad; base rounded to almost truncate; apex long acute to slightly acuminate; velutinous, especially below, becoming ± glabrous above; venation raised below, sunk above, 3(–4) primary veins on each side of the midrib; without domatia; petioles about 5–15 mm long, velutinous. Inflorescence terminal on side shoots, cymose-corymbose, crowded, about 10- to many-flowered, 4–10 cm long, 5–15 cm broad, velutinous; bracts lanceolate-linear to lanceolate, 5–20 mm long; pedicels 2–15 mm long. Calyx villous; tube 1.5–2 mm long; lobes linear-filiform, 10–17 mm long, often wavy. Corolla white; tube 15–22 mm long; lobes 7–8, 8–12 mm long, 1.5–3 mm broad. Anthers 4 mm long, sessile, connective appendage about 0.5 mm long, acute. Ovary barrel-shaped, 0.5 mm long; stigma 2.5 mm long, acute. Fruit ellipsoid, 10 x 6 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Jasminum annamense annamense. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 317. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Suffrutex or woody climber, young shoots pilose to shortly, coarsely pilose. Leaves lanceolate to narrowly lanceolate, 3–6 cm long, 0.7–3 cm broad; base rounded to narrowed onto the petiole; apex acute with a fine point; velutinous to slightly scattered villous below, becoming glabrous above except for the midrib and primary veins; veins raised below, somewhat sunk above, 2–3 primary veins in each side of the midrib; without domatia; petioles 3–5 mm long, articulate. Inflorescence terminal on side shoots, cymose-corymbose, dense, 3- to about 10-flowered, pilose; bracts linear; pedicels 1–5 mm long. Calyx tube 2 mm long; lobes 12–17 mm long, linear-filiform, densely pilose. Corolla tube 20–24 mm long; lobes 10–12 mm long, 2–4 mm broad. Fruit ellipsoid, 7 x 4 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Jasminum annamense kerrii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 319. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Woody climber or straggling shrub, young shoots glabrous. Leaves chartaceous, broadly ovate to lanceolate, to oblong-elliptic, 4–8(–10) cm long, 2–3.5(–4) cm broad; base narrowed to rarely almost rounded; apex acuminate; 3–4 primary veins on each side of the midrib, the lowest arising at an acute angle to the midrib and curving round to meet the next primary vein about half way up the lamina, venation raised above and often finely reticulate, slightly raised below; 2–3 shortly tufted domatia on each side below; petioles glabrous, 4–8 mm long. Inflorescence axillary or terminal on side shoots, cymose, glabrous, (3–)7- to about 21-flowered; bracts linear, 1–2 mm long; pedicels 1–10 mm long, that of the central flower the shortest. Calyx glabrous, tube 1.5 mm long, lobes 0 or scarcely perceptible. Corolla tube red, 13–15 mm long, lobes white or red externally, white inside, 6–7, 5–6 mm long, 1 mm broad. Fruit spheroid, 5–6 mm diameter.
bibliographicCitation: Jasminum anodontum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 329. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Woody climber, young shoots glabrous. Leaves lanceolate to broadly ovate or oblong, (7–)10–22 cm long, (3.5–)4–10.5 cm broad; base obtuse to rounded, very shortly attenuate onto the petiole; apex shortly acuminate; glabrous; 6–8(–9) primary veins on each side of the midrib, raised below and above, the lowest one short and making an obtuse angle with the midrib; without domatia; petioles glabrous, 10–15 mm long. Inflorescence axillary rarely apparently terminal, decussate racemose, 5–15 cm long, 3- to ca 23-flowered, glabrous; bracts linear, 1–2 mm long; pedicels 5–25 mm long. Calyx (1.5–)2–2.5 mm long, obconic; lobes 0.25–0.5 mm or scarcely perceptible, glabrous. Corolla white; tube 15–24 mm long; lobes 5–7, 10–15 mm long, 2.5–6 mm broad. Fruit ellipsoid, (8–)15 mm long, (5–)10 mm broad.
bibliographicCitation: Jasminum attenuatum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 332. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Woody climber. Leaves trifoliolate, chartaceous, broadly lanceolate to lanceolate, terminal leaflet 4–8 cm long, 1.8–3.8 cm broad, lateral, 3.5–6 cm long, 1.3–2.5 cm broad; base rounded to obtuse; apex long acute, often slightly acuminate; glabrous below and above; venation raised below, midrib slightly sunk above, 1(–2) pairs of basal veins forming submarginal lamina veins, 1–3 slightly obscure primary veins on each side of the midrib; without domatia; petiole 1-3 cm long, glabrous, terminal petiolule 5–10 mm long, lateral 3–8 mm long. Inflorescence axillary or terminal on side shoots, cymose paniculate, 2–10 cm long, terminal groups of flowers corymbose-clustered, slightly puberulent, especially towards the flowers; pedicels 0–1 mm long. Calyx very finely puberulent to glabrate; tube 1–1.25 mm long; lobes 0.3–0.5 mm long. Corolla white, fragrant; tube 8–12 mm long; lobes 5–6, 6–10 mm long, 2.5–3.5 mm broad. Anthers 3 mm long, connective acute. Fruit ellipsoid, 9 x 6 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Jasminum calcicola. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 311. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Woody climber or straggling shrub, young shoots finely to coarsely pilose. Leaves chartaceous, oblong-elliptic to sometimes broadly ovate or slightly obovate, 6–15 cm long, 3–7 cm broad; base narrowed to obtuse or rounded; apex shortly and finely acuminate; glabrous below and above or midrib sometimes scattered pilose towards the base; venation raised reticulate below and slightly so above with midrib sunk, 4–7 primary veins on each side of the midrib; with or without up to 4 hairy domatia in the axils of the primary veins with the midrib below; petioles 5–10 mm long, puberulent to pilose, articulate. Inflorescence terminal on side shoots, a dense head, sometimes branched with up to many subsidiary heads, (3–)5- to many-flowered, finely pubescent; bracts white or cream-coloured, leaf-like, 5–25 mm long; pedicels 0–4 mm long. Calyx tube 2 mm long; lobes filiform, 5–10(–14) mm long, finely pubescent to pilose. Corolla tube glabrous, 20–22 mm long; lobes 6–7(–8), 8–10 mm, long, 2–5 mm broad. Fruit ellipsoid, 9 x 7 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Jasminum coarctatum coarctatum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 320. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Differs from var. coarctatum in the generally more hairy young shoots, petioles and leaf midrib below, a lack of domatia, a finely velutinous inflorescence rachis, pedicels and calyx, and especially in the more or less velutinous outside of the corolla, especially the tube.
bibliographicCitation: Jasminum coarctatum vanprukii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 321. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Woody climber or scrambling shrub, young shoots puberulent. Leaves somewhat coriaceous, ovate, ovate-deltoid with rounded angles to lanceolate or narrowly lanceolate, 1.3–5.5 cm long, 0.6–2 cm broad; base truncate to very slightly cordate; apex rounded to long acute, with a very small apiculum or mucronulate; glabrous; 3- to 5-veined at the base, raised above and below, otherwise venation obscure; without domatia; petioles 1.5–5 mm long, puberulent, especially on the upper surface. Inflorescence terminal on side shoots, 1-flowered; bracts acicular, paired, 1 mm long, glabrous; pedicels 1–2 mm long. Calyx tube 1.5–2 mm long, glabrous externally, scattered puberulent within; lobes 2–5 mm long, subulate, scattered puberulent on the upper surface. Corolla white; tube 17–30 mm long; lobes 6–8, 9–17 mm long, 2.5–6 mm broad. Fruit ellipsoid-globose.
bibliographicCitation: Jasminum cordatum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 339. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Woody climber, young shoots villous. Leaves narrowly ovate to elliptic, lanceolate or slightly oblanceolate, (4–)6–14 cm long, (1.5–)2.5–4.5 cm broad; base rounded truncate; apex acute to acuminate; villous, especially on the midrib and veins below, sometimes becoming glabrous above; venation slightly raised below, 5–6 primary veins on each side of the midrib; without domatia; petioles 5–10 mm long, villous. Inflorescence axillary or terminal on side shoots, 1- to 3-flowered, villous; pedicels 5–10 mm long. Calyx tube 2.5 mm long; lobes linear-filiform, 5–8 mm long, villous. Corolla white; tube 18–20 mm long; lobes 6–7, narrow, 12–13 mm long, 2 mm broad. Anthers 4 mm long; filament 0.5 mm long, connective appendage narrowly acute, 0.2 mm long. Ovary barrel-shaped, 0.5 mm long. Fruit not known.
bibliographicCitation: Jasminum craibianum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 313. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Woody climber or low shrub, young shoots glabrous or rarely finely puberulous. Leaves to lanceolate or elliptic, (4–)7–10(–12) cm long, (2–)3.5–5(–6.5) cm broad; base obtuse to sometimes acute, attenuate onto the petiole; apex acuminate, often shortly so; glabrous; 1(–2) prominent primary veins at the base, forming a submarginal vein, 1 to 2 primary veins above, primary veins only visible, raised below, slightly sunk above; without domatia; petioles 10–20 mm long, glabrous. Inflorescence terminal on side shoots, cymose corymbose, somewhat open to fairly dense, 4–10 cm diameter, 15- to many-flowered, puberulous; basal bracts leaf-like, the upper linear; pedicels 1–5 mm long. Calyx tube 2 mm long; lobes (5–)6, narrowly acuminate-triangular, (1.5–)2(–3) mm long, exterior puberulous, pubescent within. Corolla white, fragrant; tube 7–8 mm long; lobes 7, 5–6 mm long, 3–5 mm broad. Fruit ellipsoid, 15 x 10 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Jasminum decipiens. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 337. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Woody climber, young shoots villous, to rarely almost glabrous. Leaves thickish chartaceous, ovate to lanceolate, 5–11 cm long, 2–6 cm broad; base rounded, sometimes slightly caudate; apex acute to acuminate; villous to velutinous above and especially below, rarely glabrate, persistently villous on the veins and midrib below; margins ciliolate; 3–4 primary veins on each side of the midrib; without domatia; petioles 6–16 mm long, articulate, villous, usually densely so. Inflorescence terminal on side shoots, cymose-corymbose, many-flowered, villous; bracts linear, 1–10 mm long; pedicels 0–3 mm long. Calyx tube 1–1.5 mm long; lobes (5 or) 6, linear, 1–2 mm long, often reflexed, villous to pilose. Corolla white, tube 4–6(–10) mm long; lobes 7–8, 7–8(–9) mm long. 1–2 mm broad, acute to acuminate. Fruit ellipsoid, 10 x 6 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Jasminum decussatum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 325. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Woody climber. Leaves simple or trifoliolate (to 5-foliolate pinnate outside Thailand), chartaceous; leaflets lanceolate, terminal 7–13 cm long, 4–7 cm broad, lateral 3.5–6.5 cm long, 2–3 cm broad; base rounded to truncate, sometimes subcordate; apex long acuminate, glabrous below and above; venation raised below, sunk above, 2 basal veins on each side of the midrib on terminal leaflets, 1 in lateral, 3–4 primary veins on each side of the midrib; hairy domatia at the base below and sometimes in the axils of the primary veins; petiole 1–2 cm long, terminal petiolule 1–2 cm long, lateral 2–5 mm long. Inflorescence axillary and terminal on side shoots, cymose-corymbose, shorter than the subtending leaves, glabrous; pedicels 3–7 mm long. Calyx glabrous, tube 2 mm long: lobes triangular, 0.6–0.8 mm long. Corolla white, fragrant; tube 7–10 mm long; lobes 5, ovate, 5–6 mm long, 5 mm broad. Anthers sessile, 4 mm long, connective appendage pointed, 0.5 mm long. Fruit ellipsoid, 8 x 6 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Jasminum dispermum forrestianum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 310. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or woody climber, young shoots finely to strongly pilose. Leaves ovate to narrowly lanceolate, (2–)4–9(–11) cm long, (1.5–)2–4(–6) cm broad; base rounded or sometimes obtuse or almost subcordate; apex long acute to slightly acuminate; appressed pilose to glabrous below, scattered pilose to glabrous above, midrib and main veins pilose; primary veins 2–4 on each side of the midrib, curving round below the margin, raised below, sunk above, otherwise venation obscure; without domatia; petioles 3–7(–10) mm long, finely to strongly pilose. Inflorescence terminal on side shoots, cymose-corymbose, dense, 3- to about 10-flowered, pilose to finely pilose; bracts leaf-like, 0.5–1 cm long; pedicels 0.5–3 mm long. Calyx tube 1.5–2 mm long; lobes filiform, (2–)4–11 mm long, densely to finely pilose. Corolla tube 15–25 mm long; lobes 7–9, 6–12 mm long, 2–4 mm broad. Fruit ellipsoid, 8 x 6 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Jasminum elongatum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 322. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Woody climber, young shoots glabrous. Leaves somewhat coriaceous, elliptic or elliptic-oblong to lanceolate, 5–12 cm long, 2.5–6 cm broad; base obtuse to rounded; apex acuminate, glabrous; 5–6 primary veins on each side of the midrib, the lowest at a broad angle to the midrib, veins raised below and above, finely reticulate to ± obscure; 3–4 small, slightly hairy domatia on each side; petioles glabrous, 5–8 mm long. Inflorescence terminal on side shoots, open cymose, (5- to) many-flowered, glabrous; bracts linear, 1–6 mm long; pedicels 1-10 mm long. Calyx glabrous; tube 1–1.5 mm long, lobes 0.25–0.5 mm long, triangular, broadly acute. Corolla white; tube 16–20 mm long; lobes 7, 6–12 mm long, 1–1.5 mm broad. Fruit spheroid, 5–6 mm diameter.
bibliographicCitation: Jasminum extensum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 332. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Woody climber, glabrous. Leaves trifoliolate, ± chartaceous, narrowly ovate to lanceolate, terminal leaflet 7–10 cm long, 3.5–5 cm broad, lateral 6–8.5 cm long, 3–4 cm broad; base obtuse to rounded; apex acute to slightly acuminate; glabrous below and above, venation raised, midrib sunk above, 2 almost basal veins on each side of the midrib joining with 3–5 primary veins on each side to form a submarginal vein; domatia 3–6, small, tufted; petiole 3–4 cm long, terminal petiolule 2–3 cm long, lateral 0.3–1 cm long, with a bent "pulvinus" just below the base of the petiolule. Inflorescence usually axillary or terminal on side shoots, open, cymose-decussate 7–10 cm long, 7- to 13-flowered, glabrous or very sparingly short puberulous; pedicels 3–7 mm long. Calyx tube 2 mm long; lobes insignificant, (0.1–)0.2 mm long, glabrous except for a few, small scattered hairs, especially on the rim. Corolla white; tube 25–30 mm long; lobes 15 mm long, 4–5 mm broad. Anthers 4–4.5 mm long, not including an acute, connective appendage 0.5–1 mm long. Ovary barrel-shaped, 0.5 mm long; style 2 mm long (in short styled specimen), stigma 3 mm long. Fruit (Indian specimens) broadly ellipsoid, 8 x 6 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Jasminum flexile. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 311. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: This subspecies differs from subsp. funale in young shoots petioles and inflorescence axes being pubescent, leaves slightly smaller, (2.5–)3–6(–7) cm long, (1.5–)2–4(–4.5) cm broad, velutionous below, sometimes slightly so, usually fewer flowered inflorescences, the calyx pubescent or glabrous, and the corolla tube often slightly smaller, 8–16 mm long.
bibliographicCitation: Jasminum funale sootepense. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 327. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Woody climber, young shoots glabrous. Leaves slightly coriaceous, oblong-elliptic to somewhat narrowly ovate, 5–12 cm long, 2–4 cm broad; base acute to obtuse; apex slightly acuminate; glabrous below and above; venation raised, finely and more or less reticulate below and above, with 5–6 primary veins on each side of the midrib; domatia absent or about 2 on each side in the axils of the primary veins with the midrib; petioles 4–6 mm long, glabrous. Inflorescence terminal on side shoots, cymose-paniculate, open, extended, 5- to about 15-flowered; bracts linear to linear-lanceolate, 5–15 mm long; pedicels 2–10 mm long. Calyx tube 1.5–2 mm long; lobes subulate, 5–10 mm long, glabrous. Corolla tube 18–22 mm long; lobes 7–8, 10–15 mm long, narrow, 1.5–2 mm broad, long pointed. Fruit spheroidal, about 5 mm diameter.
bibliographicCitation: Jasminum harmandianum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 317. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Woody climber, young shoots glabrous or shortly puberulent. Leaves coriaceous, ovate to lanceolate or elliptic, (5–)7–15 cm long, (2.5–)4–7 cm broad; base obtuse or rounded; apex acuminate; glabrous (in Thai plants); venation 1 or usually 2 strong primary veins on each side of the midrib in the lower half, usually forming a submarginal vein, and 1–2 smaller ones above, raised below, sunk above, reticulation ± obscure below; without domatia; petioles 6–20 mm long, angled-articulate, glabrous or very finely puberulent. Inflorescence axillary or terminal on side shoots, densely cymose-corymbose, (3–)5- to many-flowered, finely puberulous; bracts diminutive leaf-like to linear, 3–6 mm long; pedicels 2–5 mm long. Calyx finely puberulent, becoming glabrous; lobes ± ciliolate; tube 2–3 mm long, lobes subulate, 5–7 mm long. Corolla white; tube 22–25 mm long; lobes 7–8, 15–20 mm long, 5–6 mm broad. Fruit ellipsoid, 15 x 10 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Jasminum kedahense. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 337. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Woody climber, glabrous. Leaves coriaceous, elliptic-oblong to lanceolate, terminal leaflet 7–13 cm long, 3.5–6 cm broad, the lateral 5–8 cm long, 3–4 cm broad; base obtuse to rounded; apex acute to rounded and shortly acuminate; glabrous; venation slightly raised below and above, 4–6 primary veins on each side of the midrib, without basal lateral veins or domatia; petioles 1–3 cm long, terminal petiolule 1–3 cm long, lateral 1–2 cm long, usually a distinct pulvinus at the base of the lamina, often bent. Inflorescence 1–2 axillary or terminal on major side shoots, cymose-paniculate to corymbose, crowded, 6–15 cm long, glabrous, 8- to many-flowered; pedicels 0–3 mm long. Calyx tube 2 mm long; lobes triangular, 0.1–0.5 mm long, glabrous. Corolla white, fragrant; tube 18–25 mm long; lobes 12–14 mm long, 3–4 mm broad. Anthers 5.5 mm long, with an acute connective appendage 0.5 mm long. Ovary barrel-shaped, 0.5 mm long; style 4 mm long in short-styled specimen), stigma 3 mm long. Fruit spheroidal, 11 x 9 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Jasminum lanceolaria lanceolaria. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 312. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Leaves less thickly coriaceous. Corolla tube 10–15 mm long; lobes 7–12 mm long. Anthers 3 mm long, plus a very acute connective appendage 0.5 mm long. Ovary barrel-shaped, 0.5 mm long; style 14 mm long (in long-styled specimen), stigma 2 mm long. Fruit ellipsoid, 18–20 x 12–14 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Jasminum lanceolaria scortechinii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 312. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Woody climber, young shoots glabrous, slightly quadrangular. Leaves lanceolate to narrowly lanceolate, 4.5–12 cm long, 1.5–3.5 cm broad; base obtuse to rounded, apex long acute; glabrous below and above; 6–9 primary veins on each side of the midrib, obscure below and above; without domatia; petioles 5–12 mm long, glabrous. Inflorescence axillary or terminal on side shoots, cymose, 1- to 3-flowered, glabrous; bracts linear-acute, 1–3 mm long; pedicles 5–12 mm long. Calyx glabrous; tube 2–2.5 mm long; lobes ± setose, 1–1.5 mm long. Corolla white; tube 20–28 mm long; lobes 5, 15–18 mm long, 10–15 mm broad. Fruit not known.
bibliographicCitation: Jasminum latipetalum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 334. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Differs from var. laurifolium in its smaller calyx and sometimes broader leaves. Leaves very narrowly lanceolate to oblong-elliptic, 5–10 cm long, 1–3 cm broad; apex long acuminate and slightly acuminate to acuminate. Calyx tube 1-2 mm long and the lobes (1–)2–3 mm long, usually somewhat reflexed in flower.
bibliographicCitation: Jasminum laurifolium brachylobum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 335. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Woody climber, young shoots glabrous. Leaves somewhat coriaceous, very narrowly lanceolate, (6–)8–14 cm long, 1–2.5 cm broad; base narrowed and rounded onto the petiole; apex long acute and slightly acuminate; glabrous; 2 lateral veins at the base forming a submarginal vein, pinnate primary veins more or less obscure, 5 to about 12 per side, obscurely or slightly raised reticulate above and below; without domatia; petioles glabrous, 5–10 mm long, articulated. Inflorescence cymose, axillary or terminal on small side shoots, (1–)3- to 5-flowered, glabrous; bracts linear, 1 mm long; pedicels 3–30 mm long. Calyx tube 2 mm long; lobes filiform, 5–10 mm long, glabrous. Corolla tube 13–19 mm long; lobes 9–8, 13–19 mm long, 1.5–2 mm broad. Fruit not known.
bibliographicCitation: Jasminum laurifolium laurifolium. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 334. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Woody climber, young shoots puberulent or glagrous. Leaves somewhat coriaceous, narrowly ovate to oblong-ovate, 9–11.5(–17) cm long, 2.5–4.5(–8) cm broad; base obtuse (to rounded), attenuate onto the petiole; apex acuminate; glabrous; 5 primary nerves on each side of the midrib, slightly raised below, not reticulate, obscure to slightly sunk above, without domatia; petioles 10–15 mm long, glabrous or puberulent. Inflorescence terminal on side shoots, cymose, dense, 7- to many-flowered, finely pubescent, rarely remotely so, often subtended by a pair of reduced leaves; bracts linear, 3–5 mm long; pedicels 2–4 mm long. Calyx tube 2 mm long; lobes 5–10 mm long, subulate, finely pubescent to scattered puberulent. Corolla white; tube (15–)25–30 mm long; lobes (8–)12–15 mm long, (3–)5–6 mm broad. Fruit (7 × 4 mm, ellipsoid) not known in Thai specimens.
bibliographicCitation: Jasminum maingayi. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 319. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Climber or straggler, young shoots densely pilose. Leaves lanceolate-oblong to broadly ovate, (3–)4.5–6(–8) cm long, (1.8–)2–3(–6) cm broad; base subcordate to truncate; apex acute, usually slightly acuminate; velutinous to densely pilose beneath, pilose above; 4 primary veins on each side of the midrib, raised pilose below, slightly raised or sunk above, pilose, venation otherwise ± obscure; without domatia; petioles 4–15 mm long, densely pilose. Inflorescence terminal on axillary side-shoots, cymose corymbose, dense, 3- to many-flowered, densely pilose; bracts resembling reduced leaves; pedicels 0.5–2 mm long. Calyx tube 1–1.5 mm long; lobes filiform, 4-10 mm long, densely pilose. Corolla tube 12–17 mm long; lobes 7–8, 12–17 mm long, 4–5 mm broad. Fruit ellipsoid, 8 mm long, 5 mm diameter.
bibliographicCitation: Jasminum multiflorum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 321. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Woody climber, young shoots glabrous to sometimes very finely puberulent at first. Leaves ovate to narrowly ovate or broadly lanceolate to lanceolate, (2.5–)3.5–7 (–12) cm long, (1–)1.5–3.5(–4.5) cm broad; glabrous; base obtuse to rounded; apex acute to acuminate, often slenderly so; 2 main basal veins, 1 on each side of the midrib, becoming submarginal and linking up with about 3 lateral veins, raised reticulate below, ± obscure, slightly sunk above; without domatia. Inflorescence axillary, almost sessile, 1 to rarely 3-flowered, glabrous; pedicels 2–5 mm long. Calyx tube 2–3 mm long; lobes subulate, 5–12 mm long, glabrous. Corolla white; tube 12–20 mm long; lobes 7–8, 12–20 mm long, 1.5–2 mm broad. Fruit ellipsoid-spheroid, 10–12 x 8–9 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Jasminum nervosum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 339. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Woody climber, young shoots glabrous. Leaves ± coriaceous, oblong-elliptic or ovate to broadly lanceolate, rarely elliptic or narrowly elliptic, 5–14 cm long, (1.5–)2.5–5 cm broad; base acute to obtuse or rounded; apex somewhat acuminate; venation of 2 main veins arising from near the midrib base and forming a submarginal vein, sometimes with a smaller outer pair as well, 2–3 obscure lateral nerves on each side of the midrib, sometimes slightly reticulate below, usually obscure above; without domatia. Inflorescence terminal on side shoots, 1(-3)-flowered, glabrous; bracts linear, 2 mm long; pedicels 20–40 mm long. Calyx tube 2 mm long; lobes 6–10 mm long, subulate, glabrous. Corolla white, not fragrant; tube 25–35 mm long; lobes 7–9, oblong-elliptic, 8–18 mm broad. Fruit ellipsoid, 12 x 8 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Jasminum nobile rex. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 335. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Woody climber, young shoots glabrous. Leaves lanceolate, 4–5 cm long, 2.5–4 cm broad; base obtuse, slightly attenuate onto the petiole; apex long acute, slightly acuminate; glabrous; 5 primary veins on each side of the midrib, slightly raised below and above, otherwise obscure; without domatia; petioles 8–10 mm long. Inflorescence axillary, dense, cymose-corymbose, about 10- to 20-flowered, glabrous; bracts ovate, leaf-like, 1.5–2 cm long, 1–1.5 cm broad; pedicels 1–2 mm long. Calyx tube 2 mm long, lobes linear, 5–7 mm long, glabrous. Corolla white, fragrant; tube 25–30 mm long; lobes 8–9, 12–15 mm long, 5–6 mm broad. Fruit not known.
bibliographicCitation: Jasminum perissanthum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 321. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Woody climber, young shoots glabrous. Leaves chartaceous, elliptic-oblong to usually narrowly obovate or broadly oblanceolate, (4.5–)6–12(–18) cm long, (1.7–)2.5–5(–7.5) cm broad; base rounded or broadly rounded, somewhat attenuate; apex acuminate; glabrous but base of midrib above usually pilose; venation raised, ± reticulate below, somewhat obscure above, about 4 primary veins on each side of the midrib; small domatia in the axils of 1–3 primary veins with the midrib; petioles 3–5 mm long, pilose on the upper surface. Inflorescence axillary or terminal on side shoots, 1- to 9- or more-flowered, the cyme sometimes reduced to a single flower; subtended by a pair of small narrow bracts at the base of the pedicel, glabrous, bracts linear, 1–4 mm long; pedicels 2–5 mm long. Calyx tube slightly obconic or barrel-shaped, 1.5–2 mm long; lobes subulate to usually somewhat triangular, acute, 0.25–1 mm long, lobes usually arising from thickened ribs. Corolla white; tube 15–22 mm long; lobes usually 6, 9–12 mm long, 1–2 mm broad. Fruit spheroidal, 6 mm diameter.
bibliographicCitation: Jasminum pierreanum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 331. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Woody climber, young shoots densely tomentose. Leaves broadly ovate or broadly lanceolate to oblong, (4.5–)5.5–8.5(–12) cm long, 2.5–4(–5) cm broad; base rounded; apex acute, ± acuminate; pilose on the veins and midrib below, sometimes velutinous below and almost so above, margins ciliate-pilose; primary veins 4–5 on each side of the midrib, slightly raised above and below, with 2–6 tufted domatia in their axes on each side; petioles densely tomentose, 5–8 mm long. Inflorescence terminal on side shoots or less commonly axillary, crowded, cymose-corymbose. 7-to many-flowered; bracts 1–5 mm long; pedicels 0.5–1 mm long. Calyx slightly obconic, tomentose, rarely almost glabrous; tube 2(–3) mm long; lobes broadly ovate-triangular, 1 mm long, acute or blunt, plicate, ± glabrous in the folds, apices somewhat divergent, rarely 2 mm long and very acute. Corolla white; tube 18–22 mm long; lobes 6–7. 10–12 mm long, 2–4 mm broad. Fruit spheroid 7 mm diameter.
bibliographicCitation: Jasminum rambayense. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 329. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or woody climber, young shoots finely puberous. Leaves lanceolate, 3.5–8(–12) cm long, 1.5–4(–6) cm broad; base rounded; apex acute; glabrous except for puberulous midrib below; 4–5 primary veins on each side of the midrib, raised below, level or slightly sunk above; without domatia; petioles 5–6(–20) mm long, finely puberulous. Inflorescence terminal on axillary shoots, dense, cymose-coryınbose, about 5- to 15-flowered, finely puberulous; bracts leaf-like, 10–30 mm long, 6–10 mm broad; pedicels 1–3 mm long. Calyx tube 1-2 mm long; lobes subulate-triangular, (0.5–)1(–3) mm long, scattered puberulous to glabrous. Corolla white, scented; tube 10–12 mm long; lobes 5–6(–8) mm long, 1.5–2 mm broad. Fruit ellipsoid, 10–11 x 7–8 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Jasminum scandens. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 324. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Suffrutex or straggling climber, 0.25 m tall or more, often with a woody base, young shoots finely puberulent. Leaves simple, elliptic or broadly elliptic to sometimes lanceolate, (1–)3–5(–10) cm long, (0.8–)1.5–1(–5) cm broad; base attenuate onto the petiole; apex acute with a very small mucro; glabrous below and above, or minutely puberulent on the basal part of the midrib when young; venation slightly raised below and above, 3(–4) primary veins on each side of the midrib; without domatia; petiole 2–5 mm long, finely puberulent. Inflorescence terminal on side shoots, 1- to rarely 3-flowered, glabrous; pedicels 3–15 mm long. Calyx "leafy", tube 2 mm long; lobes (4–)5–15 mm long, 1–4 mm broad, elliptic, with a midrib and sometimes 2 lateral veins, very finely puberulent to glabrous. Corolla white, fragrant; tube 10–18 mm long; lobes 12–20 mm long, 2–4 mm broad, narrowly elliptic, acute. Anthers 4 mm long, ± sessile, connective appendage very small, acute. Ovary barrel-shaped about 1 mm long. Fruit spheroid 6–8 mm diameter, red (fide Geesink et al. 5861) orange (fide Geesink et al. 5592).
bibliographicCitation: Jasminum siamense. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 313. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Woody climber, young shoots densely stellate-pilose, somewhat chartaceous. Leaves oblong elliptic, sometimes somewhat narrowly ovate or slightly oblanceolate, (3.5–)6–10 cm long, (1.5–)3–4.5 cm broad; base narrowed, attenuate onto the petiole; apex acuminate; scattered stellate-pilose on both surfaces, especially below, becoming glabrate above except for the midrib and the margins; venation raised below, slightly sunk above, 2(–3) primary veins on each side of the midrib; without domatia; petioles 5–10 mm long, densely stellate-pilose. Inflorescence axillary or terminal on side shoots, compact, cymose, 3-flowered, densely stellate-pilose; bracts resembling reduced leaves or linear-lanceolate; pedicels 1–2 mm long. Calyx tube 1.5–2 mm long; lobes linear-filiform, (1.5–)2–3 mm long, densely stellate-pilose. Corolla white; tube 18–20 mm long; lobes 7, 7–10 mm long, 2–3 mm broad. Fruit unknown.
bibliographicCitation: Jasminum stellipilum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 323. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Spreading shrub or woody climber, young shoots finely puberulous. Leaves ovate to lanceolate, 4–11 cm long, 2–5 cm broad; base rounded, rarely narrowed; apex acute to acuminate; glabrous on both surfaces but midrib often puberulous towards the base; 3–4 primary veins on each side of the midrib, raised below, sunk above, otherwise venation obscure; without domatia; petioles 3–10 mm long, tomentose. Inflorescence terminal on side shoots, cymose to cymose-corymbose, 1–10 cm diameter, 5- to many - flowered, puberulous; bracts linear, 1–7 mm long; pedicels 1–6 mm long. Calyx puberulous, especially the lobes, to subglabrous; tube 1.5–2 mm long; lobes narrowly triangular-subulate, 0.5–1.5 mm long. Corolla white; tube 11–13 mm long; lobes 7–8, 7–11 mm long, 2.5–3 mm broad. Fruit [ellipsoid, 14 x 8 mm].
bibliographicCitation: Jasminum syringifolium. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 323. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Straggling shrub or small tree to about 15 m tall, young shoots finely to coarsely pubescent, lenticellate. Leaves slightly coriaceous; narrowly ovate to lanceolate or elliptic, (3–)6–9(–11) cm long, (1.5–)2.5–4(–5) cm broad; base narrowed onto the petiole, apex more or less acuminate, glabrous; 4–5 primary veins on each side of the midrib, raised below, slightly sunk above, otherwise obscure; petioles 4–10 mm long, glabrous. Inflorescence terminal, cymose-paniculate, pyramidal, 6–12 cm long from the lowest panicle branch to the apex, the lowest branch 2–9 cm long, pilose; flowers numerous, clustered; bracts few, linear-lanceolate, 0.5–1 mm long, ciliate; pedicels 0–0.5(–1) mm long. Calyx obconic, glabrous; tube 1–1.5 mm long; lobes obscure. Corolla white; tube 1.5–2 mm long; lobes 1–1.75 mm long, 1 mm broad, rounded triangular. Stamens exserted; filaments 1–1.5 mm long, slender; anthers 1–1.5 mm long; connective appendage not developed. Style 1–2 mm long, stigma 0.25–0.5 mm long. Fruit ellipsoid-spherical, 5–6 mm long, 4 mm diameter.
bibliographicCitation: Ligustrum confusum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 294. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or small tree to about 8 m tall, young shoots glabrous or pubescent, lenticellate. Leaves slightly coriaceous, lanceolate, sometimes more or less elliptic, (6.5–)8–13 cm long, (2.5–)3–4 cm broad; base narrowed onto the petiole; apex acuminate, glabrous; 6–9 primary veins on each side of the midrib, raised below, slightly raised above, otherwise venation obscure; petioles 5–12 mm long, glabrous. Inflorescence terminal, cymose paniculate, pyramidal, (8–)15–20 cm from the bottom panicle branch to the tip, the bottom branch (6–)9–15 cm long, glabrous or scattered pubescent; bracts absent; pedicels 1–3 mm long. Calyx glabrous; tube 0.75 mm long; lobes obscure, very shallowly triangular. Corolla white; tube 1.5 mm long; lobes 1.25 mm long, 0.75 mm broad. Stamens just exserted; anthers 1 mm long. Style 1.25 mm long, stigma 0.25 mm long. Fruit ellipsoid, slightly asymmetrical, 9 mm long, 6 mm broad.
bibliographicCitation: Ligustrum robustum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 294. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or small tree to about 3 m tall; young shoots densely pubescent with long and short hairs. Leaves chartaceous or slightly coriaceous; ovate to broadly lanceolate, sometimes more or less elliptic, (2.5–)3–6 cm long, (1.5–)2–3 cm broad; base acute to almost rounded; apex acute and slightly acuminate to acute-rounded; softly pilose below, at least on the midib, scattered pilose becoming glabrous above; 4 primary veins on each side of the midrib, raised below, slightly sunk to obscure above, venation slightly raised below, obscure above; petioles 3–5 mm long, densely pubescent. Inflorescence terminal, cymose-paniculate, pyramidal, 4–10 cm long from the lowest panicle branch to the tip, the lowest branches 1.5–4 cm long, densely pubescent with long and short hairs; flowers numerous; bracts sometimes leafy; pedicels 1–4 mm long. Calyx obconic, glabrous; tube 0.5 mm long; lobes scarcely perceptible or absent. Corolla white; tube 0.75 mm long; lobes 2–2.25 mm long, 1–1.25 broad. Stamens long exserted; filaments 3 mm long; anthers 1–1.25 mm long, connective not really developed. Style 1.5–2 mm long, stigma 0.25–0.5 mm long. Fruit spherical, 5 mm diameter.
bibliographicCitation: Ligustrum sinense. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 297. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Yellowish-white or reddish herb up to 30 cm. Stems glabrous or pubescent in upper part. Leaves ovate-oblong, crowded towards the base, 5–15 mm long, entire or fimbriate. Inflorescence with 3–10 flowers; pedicel 6–15 mm; bracts ovate, to 18 mm. Flowers 4–5-merous. Sepals ovate-spathulate, 6–13 mm, Petals oblong to spathulate, as long as sepals, saccate at base, keeled and often recurved at apex, glabrous outside, with stiff, white hairs inside. Stamens shorter than corolla, glabrous or pubescent; filaments ca 10 mm; anthers hippocrepidoform, ca 2 mm. Ovary 4–5-locular, glabrous or pubescent; style impressed, 1.5–3.5 mm; stigma umbilicate. Capsule 6–10 mm long, 4–8 mm diam. Seeds minute, 0.5–1 mm long.
bibliographicCitation: Monotropa hypopitys. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 266. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Small tree up to 20 m. Young branches usually densely hairy and with scattered yellow glands. Leaves coriaceous, lanceolate to oblong-ovate, with narrow, rounded or cordate base; apex usually acute, somtimes rounded, both surfaces ± pubescent, sometimes almost glabrous and shining on upper surface, and with numerous yellowish glands, particularly on the lower side; midrib prominent, lateral nerves arching, not reaching the margin; 6–17 by 2–5 cm; petiole 2–5 mm. Small stipules are present in the very young plants. Male inflorescence erect, rather lax, 3–5 cm on a short peduncle. Stamens 2–4. Female inflorescence ± dense, 4–8 cm. Both type of inflorescensces ± hairy and with yellow glands. Drupe red, ellipsoid-subglobose, ca 1 cm diam.
bibliographicCitation: Myrica esculenta. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 268. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Woody climber, young shoots glabrous, 4-angled. Leaves coriaceous, oblong lanceolate to elliptic, (6–)9–18 cm long, (3–)4–7.5 cm broad; base obtuse to rounded; apex slightly acuminate, glabrous; margins entire; venation with 1 strong primary vein form the base on each side of the midrib reaching the apex, raised below, sunk above, 4–6 more minor veins on each side, raised reticulate below, obscure to raised above; petiole 5–15 mm long, grooved above. Inflorescence axillary, open paniculate, (6–)20–35 cm long, to 20 cm broad, many-flowered, very finely puberulent; bracts linear lanceolate, acute, 1–5 mm long; pedicels 0–1 mm long. Calyx finely puberulent; tube 0.25 mm long; lobes triangular, 0.5 mm long. Corolla tube 1.5 mm long; lobes 1–1.5 mm long, with margins reflexed. Stamens subsessile: anthers ovoid-ellipsoid, 0.5 mm long; connective developed into a short appendage. Ovary rounded-conoid, 0.75 mm long; style obscure, stigma bilobed, 0.2 mm long. Fruit ± globose, 16–19 long, 13–17 mm diameter.
bibliographicCitation: Myxopyrum pierrei. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 304. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: This subspecies differs from subsp. smilacifolium in its generally slightly smaller and narrower leaves, (5–)8–16 cm long, (2–)3.5–7 cm broad, its smaller inflorescence, 2.5–6 cm long, 2 cm broad, a smaller calyx with a tube 0.2 mm long and lobes 0.25 mm long, a smaller corolla with a tube and lobes each about 1 mm long, and larger fruits, 8–15 mm long, 10–12 mm broad.
bibliographicCitation: Myxopyrum smilacifolium confertum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 306. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Woody climber, young shoots glabrous. Leaves ovate to lanceolate or elliptic, (5–)8–15(–20) cm long, (2.5–)3.5–6(–10) cm broad; base acute to rounded; apex acute to slightly acuminate, glabrous; margins entire or finely serrate in the upper half of lamina; 1 prominent primary vein arising from the lamina base on each side of the midrib with 3–4 less prominent viens above, raised below, immersed above, venation raised reticulate below and above. Inflorescence axillary, cymose-paniculate, (3–)5–19 cm long, to 12 cm broad, branches divaricate, finely puberulent; many- to numerously flowered; bracts small, linear-lanceolate, 1–3 mm long; pedicels 0–0.5 mm long. Calyx finely puberulent; tube 0.25 mm long; lobes triangular, 0.5 mm long. Corolla greenish yellow, tube 1.5 mm long, lobes 2 mm long, 0.5 mm broad, the margins curled inwards. Stamens subsessile; anthers ellipsoid, 0.5 mm long; the connective with a small acute appendage. Ovary rounded, 0.5 mm tall; style obscure, stigma 0.2 mm long, bilobed. Fruit spheroid, 5–10 mm long, 5–13 mm broad.
bibliographicCitation: Myxopyrum smilacifolium smilacifolium. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 305. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or small tree, 1.5–8 m tall, dioecious, young shoots finely pubescent. Leaves ± coriaceous, glabrous, ovate to broadly lanceolate or oblong-elliptic, (3–)5–9 (–12) by (1.5–)2–3.5(–7) cm; base acute to sometimes obtuse; apex acuminate; margins entire or dentate-serrate in the upper half; primary veins 5–7 on each side of the midrib, usually sunk, sometimes raised below, ± obscure above; petioles 3–5 mm long, puberulent when young, rarely glabrous. Inflorescence axillary, paniculate, ultimate branches subumbellate, (1–)1.5–2.5(–6) cm long, glabrous or puberulent; pedicels 1–3 mm long. Calyx ± 1 mm long, lobed almost to base, glabrous with ciliolate tip. Corolla tube 1.5–2.5 mm long; lobes 0.75–1.5 mm long, rounded, strongly hooded. Anthers broadly elliptic, ± 1 mm long; filaments ± 0.5 mm long. Ovary conical to cylindrical, 1–2 mm long; style short, stigma capitate, bilobed. Drupe ovoid to ellipsoid, 5–7 by 4–5 mm, blue-black when ripe.
bibliographicCitation: Olea brachiata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 272. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree to about 7 m tall, young shoots finely puberulent at first. Leaves coriaceous, glabrous, lanceolate to broadly lanceolate, 15–20 by 6–7 cm; base attenuate onto the petiole; apex slightly acuminate; margins entire, 9–10 primary veins on each side of the midrib, otherwise venation obscure; petioles 1–1.5 cm long, glabrous. Inflorescence axillary, paniculate, 2–3 cm long, several-flowered, rachis densely pilose. Calyx tube 0.5 mm long; lobes 1–1.5 mm long, triangular, densely pilose. Corolla somewhat cylindrical; tube 4 mm long; lobes narrowly oblong-elliptic, 2 mm long. Stamens not seen. Ovary cylindrical-conical, about 2 mm long; style short, stigma bilobed. Drupe not seen.
bibliographicCitation: Olea gagnepainii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 276. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree 8 m tall or more, monoecious, young stems glabrous. Leaves slightly coriaceous, ovate (5–)6–10(–13) by (2–)2.5–3.5(–5) cm; scattered peltate-lepidote, especially on the midrib below; base acute or obtuse; apex acuminate; margins entire; venation ± obscure, primary veins 5–6 on each side of the midrib, usually with domatia in the axils with the midrib below. Inflorescence terminal, paniculate-cymose, 3–10 cm long, many-flowered; rachis somewhat peltate-lepidote; pedicels 0–2 mm long. Calyx ± mm long, peltate-lepidote. Corolla white, somewhat campanulate; tube 1 mm long; lobes 2 mm long, reflexed at full anthesis; exterior peltate-lepidote. Anthers oblong, 1.5 mm long; filaments slender, 1 mm long. Ovary globose-conical, ± 1 mm long; style short, stigma bilobed. Drupe ovoid-pyriform, sometimes slightly oblique, 1.2–1.5 by 0.5–0.6 cm; mesocarp thin, blue-black when ripe.
bibliographicCitation: Olea paniculata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 278. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or small tree to 10 m tall, dioecious, young shoots pilose, often densely so. Leaves somewhat coriaceous, broadly lanceolate to lanceolate or oblong-elliptic, rarely slightly oblanceolate, (5–)8–13(–16) by (2–)2.5–4(–6) cm, pilose velutinous below, especially along the midrib, to ± glabrous; base acute or sometimes obtuse; apex acuminate to long-acute; margins entire or dentate-serrate, especially in the upper half, 6–8(–9) primary veins on each side of the midrib, raised below, usually sunk above; petioles 5–10 mm long, pilose, often densely so. Inflorescence axillary, paniculate, ends of branches subumbellate, many-flowered, 2–8 cm long, finely velutinous to pilose; pedicels 0–1(–2) mm long. Calyx ± 1 mm long, divided to about half way, glabrous, sometimes pilose, ciliolate. Corolla white, yellow, greenish-yellow or pink; lobes 1 mm long, rounded, hooded, the male obpyriform; tube 1 mm long, female ± cylindrical, 3 mm long. Anthers about 1 mm long, ellipsoid. Ovary conical, 1.5–2 mm long; style short, stigma small, bilobed. Drupe obliquely ellipsoid, 12 by 5–6 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Olea rosea. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 276. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or tree to 15 m tall, dioecious, young shoots glabrescent or pubescent. Leaves coriaceous, glabrous, lanceolate, sometimes broadly so, (5–)9–15(–24) by (2–)3–5(–6.5) cm; base acute to usually obtuse; apex acuminate to long acute; margins entire or dentate-serrate, especially in the upper half; primary veins only visible, 6–8 on each side of the midrib; petioles 3–15 mm long, glabrous or puberulent. Inflorescence axillary or terminal on side shoots, paniculate, 6–15 cm long, ultimate branches subumbellate, glabrous or puberulent; pedicels 0.5–3 mm long. Calyx ± 1 mm long, lobed to half length, glabrous or puberulent, ciliolate. Corolla yellow or white; tube 1.5–4 mm long; lobes 1 mm long, rounded, hooded. Anthers broadly ellipsoid, 0.5–1 mm long, subsessile at base of corolla tube. Ovary rounded-conical, 1–2 mm long; style short, stigma bilobed. Drupe ovoid to ellipsoid, 10–12 by 6 mm.
bibliographicCitation: Olea salicifolia. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 274. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Evergreen shrub or tree to 7 m tall, young shoots glabrous, lenticellate. Leaves somewhat coriaceous, lanceolate to oblong-elliptic, (5–)8–12(–15) cm long, (1.5–)2–4.5(–5) cm broad; base narrowed, slightly decurrent onto the petiole; apex acuminate, tip acute, glabrous; margins entire; about 9 primary veins on each side of the midrib, slightly raised below and above, somewhat reticulate, often obscurely so above; petioles glabrous, 6–25 mm long. Inflorescence axillary, fasciculate, 2(–3) buds per axil, each to about 9-flowered; flowers sweetly fragrant; pedicels glabrous, 4–15 mm long; basal bracts about 3 mm long, cuspidate. Calyx tube and lobes about 0.5 mm long, lobes triangular, somewhat erose. Corolla white or cream; tube 1–1.5 mm long; lobes 2–3 mm long, oblong, rounded. Stamens attached near the top of the corolla tube; filaments 0.5 mm long; anthers 1 mm long with a small terminal appendage. Ovary about 1.5 mm tall; style about 0.5 mm long, stigma bilobed. Drupe ellipsoid, about 2 cm long, 1 cm diameter, apex somewhat acuminate; endocarp hard, slightly ribbed.
bibliographicCitation: Osmanthus fragrans. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 279. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Evergreen tree to about 8 m tall, young shoots glabrous. Leaves somewhat chartaceous; oblanceolate, sometimes broadly so, (6–)8–12 cm long, (2.5–)3–4.5 cm broad; base acute, narrowed onto the petiole; apex shortly acuminate, glabrous; 8–9 primary veins on each side of the midrib, raised below, slightly sunk above, secondary venation slightly visible; petioles glabrous, 1.5–2 cm long. Inflorescence axillary, cymose, paniculate, 1.5–2 cm long, 10- to 30-flowered, slightly puberulous; bracts linear-triangular, 1–2 mm long, caducous; pedicels 1–3 mm long; flowers functionally unisexual. Calyx campanulate; tube about 0.5 mm long; lobes about 0.5 mm long, rounded triangular, ciliate. Corolla white; tube 1.5–2 mm long; lobes rounded 1–1.5 mm long. Stamens in functionally male flowers exserted; filaments attached at the top of the corolla tube, about 1 mm long; anthers elliptic, about 0.5 mm long, without a terminal appendage. Ovary in functionally female flowers about 1 mm long; style about 3 mm long, stigma capitate, slightly bilobed. Drupe ellipsoidal 15–20 mm long, 6–8 mm diameter, purple or blue-black when ripe; endocarp hard, ribbed.
bibliographicCitation: Osmanthus matsumuranus. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 281. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Small trees or shrubs to 18 m tall; young shoots glabrous or puberulous. Leaves coriaceous, glabrous, elliptic to broadly elliptic, 5–10 cm long, 3–5 cm broad; base narrowed, slightly decurrent onto the petiole; apex acute, very slightly acuminate; margins entire; 5 or 6 primary veins on each side of the midrib, slightly raised above and below; petioles 0.5–2 cm long. Inflorescence axillary, compact cymose-paniculate, 0.6–2 cm long, 5–10-flowered; pedicels 2–10 mm long; bracts ovate, 1–2 mm long. Calyx minutely puberulous or glabrous, 1.5–3 mm long. Corolla tube, 2–2.5 mm long, lobes truncate-rounded, 1.5–2 mm long. Stamens 2–4; filaments 0.5–2 mm long, attached near the top of the corolla tube; anthers 0.5–1 mm long, without a small, terminal appendage. Ovary 1–2 mm long, style 1–4 mm long, stigma slightly bilobed. Drupe ellipsoid, 8–15 mm long, 6–12 mm diameter.
bibliographicCitation: Osmanthus scortechinii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 279. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Small, deciduous tree to about 15 m tall, young shoots pubescent. Leaves 20-30 cm long, with 5–7 leaflets, leaflets ovate to lanceolate or elliptic-oblong, (7–)8–11(–15) cm long, (2.5–)4–5(–9) cm broad; base narrowed, attenuate onto the petiolule to rounded; apex acute to somewhat acuminate; softly pubescent below, scattered pubescent above or glabrous; margins entire; (6–)7 primary veins on each side of the midrib, raised below, immersed above, venation reticulate; petioles 6–10 cm long, swollen at the base, pubescent, at least when young, lateral petiolules 5–15 mm long, articulated with the rachis, terminal petiolules 15–40 mm long. Inflorescence terminal, cymose-paniculate, corymbose, 6–10(–15) cm long, many-flowered, glabrous or slightly pubescent; bracts linear-lanceolate, early caducous; pedicels 1–5 mm long. Calyx campanulate, puberulent; tube 2–3 mm long, accrescent in fruit; lobes obscure. Corolla salver-shaped; tube 8–11 mm long; lobes 6–7, 4–6 mm long, 4 mm broad, obovate to somewhat obcuneate, rounded to slightly emarginate, upper surface covered with brown, swollen hairs. Anthers 2 mm long; filaments very short; connective not developed into an appendage. Ovary 1 mm tall; style 5 or 10 mm long, slightly bilobed, stigma capitate, 0.75 mm long. Capsule hard, woody, obpyriform, 5–6 cm long, 3–3.5 cm diameter; seeds 3–4 cm long, winged, embryo basal on one side.
bibliographicCitation: Schrebera swietenioides. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 2, 2000. Pg. 298. Accessed 2021-07-31
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Herb richly branched from the ± lignified base, branches erect or ascending, often patent in lower part. Leaves sessile, often slightly curved, green or glaucous often becoming deep red when older, 2–5 mm with acuminate apex. Inflorescence panicles terminal on the upper branches, up to 15 cm; flowers in glomerules of 3–5, or in the upper part solitary, bisexual. Bracts similar to the leaves in lower part of inflorescence, strongly reduced in upper part; bracteoles 2–3 at base of the perianth, minute, 0.5–1 mm, scarious, persistent. Perianth greenish or reddish, ca 2 mm. Ovary ovoid; styles 2–3, long exserted. Fruit enclosed in the perianth, fleshy, 2–2.5 mm diam. Seeds dark brown, shining.

description: Perennial herb, sparingly hirsute. Leaves 2–7.5 cm long; stipules ovate-lanceolate, 4–7 mm long, acuminate, persistent; leaflets 5–8, subsessile, oblong or oblong-lanceolate, 6–22 by 2.5–9 mm; apiculate, base obliquely rounded-cordate, grey pubescent beneath. Flowers about 3 cm in diam; peduncle slender, 2-4 cm as long as leaves. Sepals narrowly lanceolate, 7–11 mm long, silkym caducous. Petals obovate, 8–10 by 4–5 mm. Stamens 8–10 in 2 whorls; filament 3–5 mm long. Ovary 1–2 min in diam. Fruit stalk 2–5.5 cm long; mericarps 8 by 4 mm, with 2 lateral spines 5–10 mm long and 2 basal spines 2 mm long.

description: Annual or biennial herb, branches up to 90 cm long, coarsely hairy. Leaves (2.5–)8–9(–18) cm long; leaflets 5–7 pairs, obliquely oblong, 4–8 by 1–5 mm long, apex acute or obtuse, base oblique, entire, silky. Flowers ca 2 cm in diam; peduncle 5–10 mm long, often exceeding the petals. Sepals linear-lanceolate, 3–6 by 1–2 mm, caducous. Petals obovate, 4–8 by 3–5 mm. Stamens 8–10 in 2 whorls; filaments up to 3 mm long. Ovary ca 1 mm in diam. Fruit stalk 1–1.5 cm long; mericarps 4–5 by 2–3 mm, short and long white hairs, with 2 pairs of sharp stiff spines.
